Parietaria.



Parietaria officinalis. Pellitory-of-the-Wall. N. O. Urticaceæ. Tincture
        of fresh plant.



Clinical. ─   Calculi. Nightmare.



Characteristics. ─     Pariet  .
        belongs to the nettles. It grows on old walls, and its ashes contain much Nitre (  K. nit  .). Cooper has used it with success in a case of renal
        calculus; and in one case it produced nightmare, the patient dreaming of being buried alive
        in the midst of ruins.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Urt. urens, Kali nit.
